verdict.rationale: Polar acts as Merchant of Record and states that it calculates, collects, and remits taxes worldwide, taking on liability for international sales taxes. It also offers organization-level and per-price control over tax-inclusive pricing. The evidence is limited to short first-party claims; missing for 10: detailed docs on how VAT/GST/sales tax rates are determined per jurisdiction and transaction (e.g., B2B reverse charge, tax ID validation), tax breakdowns on invoices or receipts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
